profile.name: Akhlaque Ahmad
profile.summary: Lead Engineer with 5.5+ years of experience developing enterprise B2B SaaS applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and REST APIs. Specialized in scalable frontend architecture, reusable component development, Node.js BFF services, and AI-enabled enterprise applications. Hands-on experience integrating LiteLLM/OpenAI models, Server-Sent Events (SSE), MCP, and Web Components to build intelligent sourcing solutions. Experienced in performance optimization, production support, code reviews, feature ownership, and delivering high-quality software in Agile environments.
profile.hobby: When I'm not coding, I'm usually diving into the latest tech trends—podcasts, GitHub, documentation rabbit holes. I'm a casual gamer (mobile games mostly), love hanging out with friends, and I travel whenever I can to soak up new cultures and perspectives. I think the best engineers are curious about the world, not just the code.

projects.name: iSource (Enterprise Sourcing Platform)
projects.description: A high-scale sourcing platform with a lazy-loaded architecture, built using Angular DewDrops UI and a Node/Express BFF that aggregates multi-product APIs.
highlights: Built and maintained iSource DewDrops UI for events, QuickSource, approvals, admin, and BOQ workflows.
Developed a Node.js BFF aggregating multi-product APIs (isource, ana-negotiation, ilogix, eproc) with Consul.
Integrated Ably realtime, STOMP messaging, Highcharts analytics, and complex drag-and-drop sourcing UX.
Delivered autonomous chat modules inside iSource (buyer/CP chat) collaborating across UI, BFF, and Java backends.

projects.name: Merlin Assist & Merlin Agentic Platform (MAP)
projects.description: An AI-powered assist chat PWA embedded across the enterprise, powered by a Spring Boot backend orchestrating multi-model LLMs and agentic workflows.
highlights: Built Merlin Assist chat PWA (React/Vite/MUI) featuring adaptive cards, OCR, and Microsoft Teams/Slack integrations.
Embedded the React chat as a UMD bundle into Angular/DewDrops hosts ensuring Zone.js compatibility.
Implemented shared common-chat Angular UI + BFF with AI streaming and MCP tools auto-derived from BFF routes.

projects.name: Autonomous Negotiation (AI-Assisted Sourcing)
projects.description: An autonomous negotiation module and product-pluggable chat shell spanning a buyer chat interface and supplier portal, powered by real-time messaging, streaming AI capabilities, and MCP tools.
highlights: Built DewDrops Angular UI for autonomous negotiation and a product-pluggable common-chat shell utilized across registries.
Designed Node/Express BFF handling AI negotiation, supplier responses, AI streaming, and chat-stream delegation.
Integrated Ably realtime pub/sub for live chat and exposed BFF routes as MCP tools for seamless AI agent integrations.
Wired streaming AI chat with Markdown and PDF rendering, establishing shared patterns across MAP-assisted flows.

projects.name: BOM / BOQ (Bill of Materials & Pricing)
projects.description: An advanced micro-application for building and pricing Bills of Materials, featuring formula builders and robust queued import/export pipelines.
highlights: Built BOM AppX UI featuring a BOM builder, alternate-supplier views, and a complex mathjs-driven formula builder.
Implemented BOM BFF for pricing tables, buyer/supplier responses, and iContract BOM variants.
Delivered BOQ import/export BFF utilizing Excel/CSV pipelines, Redis/BullMQ job queues, and AWS SDK integrations.
Built the BOQ pricing table micro-app (UI + BFF) enabling view-response pricing grids in sourcing events.
